title: GTA 6 already has 2 updates before launch
yt_title: GTA 6 already has 2 updates… before launch 🤯
description: GTA 6 isn't out yet but already got two updates: 1.002.000 (Nov 13) and 1.002.001 (Nov 16), with no patch notes from Rockstar. Sizes are dataminer reports (unconfirmed). Rockstar recommends up to 212 GB free; the viral 676 GB figure is fake.
tiktok_caption: GTA 6 already has 2 updates and it's not even out 🤯 Did yours download? 👇

lines.text: GTA 6 isn't even out, and it already has two updates.
lines.headline: 2 UPDATES ALREADY

lines.text: The first dropped November 13th. The second, November 16th.
lines.headline: NOV 13 + NOV 16

lines.text: And Rockstar hasn't published any patch notes.
lines.headline: NO PATCH NOTES

lines.text: The latest is reportedly about 600 megs on PS5, and 1.6 gigs on Xbox.
That comes on top of the preload. Rockstar recommends up to 212 gigs free.
lines.headline: 212 GB

lines.text: That viral 676 gig install size? Fake.
Launch is November 19th, on PS5 and Xbox Series.
lines.headline: NOV 19

lines.text: Update before launch night, so you're not stuck downloading. Follow for confirmed GTA 6 news.
lines.headline: UPDATE NOW
